C-RELEASE-MANUAL-PUBLISH.Name: Release timing repeal — implementation plan
C-RELEASE-MANUAL-PUBLISH.IntentSummary: Repeal the C-RELEASE-TIMING timer-default publication: remove the veto-window job and its Telegram notify from release.yml, restore the synchronous release Environment approval on the publish job (the pre-v3.0.0 shape), swap governance back from release-notify to release in lockstep (.github/release-governance.json + tools/release-governance.mjs), re-pin the workflow-contract tests, update docs/release-process.md and the M-046/V-M-046 current-state artifacts, and record the owner's one-time GitHub cleanup. The de-duplicated build lane and warmer cargo caches stay untouched.

MustContain.Text: arms a bounded no-veto window instead of a second synchronous owner approval
publishes only a verified draft after the owner approves the release environment

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: spec.xml records the owner's 2026-10-26 instruction (translated quote with speaker and date), the three scoping decisions, the VerificationIntent gates, and the PR #75 dependency; plan.xml passes the grace change-plan schema and both pass grace lint.

T-002.Title: release.yml — remove the window, restore the synchronous publish gate

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The veto-window job (173-238) is deleted; publish needs [build, prepare-publication] and declares environment: release; the draft digest/read-back path is byte-identical; the file header contract is rewritten (PURPOSE/SCOPE/DEPENDS drop the window/notify/RELEASE_VETO_MINUTES wording, MODULE_MAP loses the veto-window entry, VERSION bumps, CHANGE_SUMMARY entry added without rewriting the v3.0.0 entry).

T-003.Title: Governance lockstep — release-notify back to release

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .github/release-governance.json declares the release Environment (reviewer xronocode, v* tags) and no release-notify or TG secret boundary/forbiddenAtRepository entries; tools/release-governance.mjs validates release again with its VERSION advanced and a CHANGE_SUMMARY entry; the dry-run still reports 4 upsert-environment operations and a journal of 8 (the set changes by name, not by count).

docs/release-process.md lines 75-77 describe publish waiting on the explicit release-Environment approval; a grep over docs/release-trains/README.md for RELEASE_VETO and release-notify finds no operative timer guidance after PR #75 (setup-facts alignment commit fd1b697c) — any residue is fixed in this task.

release-github-controls.test.js: the veto-window shape test (256-276) is removed; publish needs/environment pins restored (217-218); release-Environment governance pins restored (309-315); the unknown-policy simulation moves back from release-notify to release (416-417); dry-run and journal invariants stay 4 and 8; file VERSION and CHANGE_SUMMARY advanced; release-preflight.test.js untouched.

M-046 Summary (2431-2444) and V-M-046 scenario-31 (2451-2468) drop only the window/notify sentences; the four BLOCK_RELEASE_VETO_WINDOW_* markers (2509-2512) are removed; the de-dup/cache sentences survive annotated as C-RELEASE-TIMING legacy kept; the LegacyBase provenance block is byte-identical; grace lint reports zero findings for every file in the ObservedWriteScope.

T-007.Title: Owner one-time cleanup + first live observation (post-merge)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The owner confirms the legacy release Environment reviewer (already verified present 2026-10-26), deletes release-notify and its TG secrets in the GitHub UI, and leaves RELEASE_VETO_MINUTES unset; the first release after the repeal shows the publish job paused on the release-Environment approval and no veto-window job.

npm run release:github-controls -- --dry-run (checkout-only) — operations=8 with release (not release-notify) in the environment plan.
grace lint --path . --assertions current — zero findings in this change's scope.
grace status --path . --with modules --json — healthy before handoff.

C-1.Name: Silence never publishes
C-1.Expected: After the repeal, no workflow path publishes without an explicit owner approval: publish declares environment: release; no schedule, timer or silence window exists anywhere in the repo; workflow_dispatch feeds only the unsigned manual-build QA job which has no publish path.

C-2.Name: Legacy Environment is alive
C-2.Expected: The release Environment kept required_reviewers [xronocode] and the v* tag policy through the C-RELEASE-TIMING era (T-008 deletion never executed; verified live 2026-10-26), so the restored gate is active immediately on merge — the P2 UI steps are cleanup, not a correctness precondition.

C-3.Name: Draft-first path byte-identical
C-3.Expected: The publish job still creates a draft, verifies digests byte-for-byte, edits draft=false and proves BLOCK_RELEASE_LATEST_ADVANCED; only the hold point changes (timer window → synchronous environment approval).

C-4.Name: De-dup lane and caches survive
C-4.Expected: The release build job keeps the C-RELEASE-TIMING de-duplicated lane and cargo caches; release-preflight.test.js is not edited; strictRequiredChecks and train manifest requiredChecks are unchanged, so no open train is forced to re-roll.

C-5.Name: Governance lockstep
C-5.Expected: The JSON and the validator change in the same commit: release re-declared with reviewer xronocode and v* tags, release-notify and its TG secret boundary gone; release:governance passes locally; the dry-run invariants stay 4 environments / 8 operations (name swap, not a count change).

C-6.Name: Conveyor untouched
C-6.Expected: promote-release.yml authorize-tag (the first owner instruction creating the tag) and the publish-cask job (environment release-cask) are not edited; already-sealed tags run the workflow at their seal commit, so in-flight trains are unaffected.

C-7.Name: Rollback stays possible
C-7.Expected: The release Environment is never deleted, so reverting the workflow commit restores the timer shape (v3.1.1) and re-applying this change restores manual-only — no GitHub-state rollback is ever required; release-notify deletion is safe because nothing references it after this change.

C-8.Name: Owner flow and wall time
C-8.Expected: Two explicit approvals per release (release-authorize for the tag, release for publication); the ~2h21m worst-case wait returns by design and is accepted in the spec; no Telegram ping fires (a post-build notify channel is an explicit NonGoal, proposed separately if wanted).

C-9.Name: Test matrix truthfulness
C-9.Expected: No veto-window or no-veto assertion remains in any test; the unknown-policy simulation targets release; the governance dry-run test pins 4 upsert-environment operations and journal length 8.

C-10.Name: Parallel-session coexistence
C-10.Expected: Edits are additive or in-place in files owned by this change's scope; the shared main worktree's uncommitted parallel-session files are untouched; grace lint gains zero findings referencing this change's files.

Correctness.Note: Four findings fixed before any code: (1) the draft spec lacked the required VerificationIntent section and failed its own lint gate — added with the five gates now recorded; (2) the evidence citation for run 40074378466 overstated "green" — the publish/cask jobs succeeded while the run's overall failure came from the unrelated close-release-please job; corrected in the Summary; (3) the R-6 grace ranges invited over-deletion (the de-dup/cache sentences live inside the same ranges) — narrowed to window/notify sentences plus the four markers, with the kept legacy annotated; (4) the dry-run/journal numbers were hedged ("if the environment set changes") though they are invariants — pinned at 4 and 8 (name swap, not count).

Security.Note: One operational finding with teeth: PR #75's owner Environment checklist still instructed creating release-notify TG secrets and deleting the legacy release Environment — the exact gate this change restores. PR #75 amended (commit fd1b697c): keep release (confirm reviewer, never delete), retire release-notify after this change lands, leave RELEASE_VETO_MINUTES unset; the spec's README scope rewritten to a residue audit with an explicit ordering dependency on PR #75. Language Policy also enforced: the owner's Russian chat quote translated with speaker and date kept.
